mapper.sql: role_id AS "roleId",role_nm AS "name",data_scope_cd AS "dataScope",snstv_view_yn AS "sensitiveYn", sys_role_yn AS "systemYn",use_yn AS "useYn",sort_ord AS "sortOrder"
mapper.select: SELECT FROM tb_sy_role ORDER BY sort_ord,role_id

SELECT m.menu_id AS "menuId",coalesce(a.inq_yn,'N')='Y' AS "inquire",coalesce(a.reg_yn,'N')='Y' AS "register", coalesce(a.upd_yn,'N')='Y' AS "update",coalesce(a.del_yn,'N')='Y' AS "delete",coalesce(a.upld_yn,'N')='Y' AS "upload", coalesce(a.dnld_yn,'N')='Y' AS "download",coalesce(a.cnfm_yn,'N')='Y' AS "confirm",m.upper_menu_id AS "parentId", m.menu_nm AS "name",m.scrn_id AS "screenId",m.use_yn='Y' AS "use" FROM tb_sy_menu m LEFT JOIN tb_sy_menu p ON p.menu_id=m.upper_menu_id LEFT JOIN tb_sy_role_menu_auth a ON a.menu_id=m.menu_id AND a.role_id=#{roleId} WHERE m.menu_lvl=2 ORDER BY p.sort_ord,p.menu_id,m.sort_ord,m.menu_id
mapper.sql: SELECT menu_id,upper_menu_id,menu_lvl,scrn_id FROM tb_sy_menu WHERE menu_lvl=2 ORDER BY menu_id

SELECT json_build_object('role',row_to_json(r),'permissions', (SELECT coalesce(json_agg(row_to_json(a) ORDER BY a.menu_id),'[]'::json) FROM tb_sy_role_menu_auth a WHERE a.role_id=r.role_id), 'menuIds',(SELECT coalesce(json_agg(row_to_json(m)),'[]'::json) FROM () m))::text FROM tb_sy_role r WHERE r.role_id=#{roleId}

SELECT json_build_object('roles',(SELECT coalesce(json_agg(row_to_json(r)),'[]'::json) FROM (SELECT * FROM tb_sy_role ORDER BY role_id) r), 'permissions',(SELECT coalesce(json_agg(row_to_json(a)),'[]'::json) FROM (SELECT * FROM tb_sy_role_menu_auth ORDER BY role_id,menu_id) a), 'menus',(SELECT coalesce(json_agg(row_to_json(m)),'[]'::json) FROM (SELECT * FROM tb_sy_menu ORDER BY menu_id) m))::text
mapper.update: UPDATE tb_sy_role_menu_auth SET inq_yn=#{inq},reg_yn=#{reg},upd_yn=#{upd},del_yn=#{del},upld_yn=#{upld},dnld_yn=#{dnld},cnfm_yn=#{cnfm}, mod_user_id=#{actor},mod_dttm=#{now} WHERE role_id=#{roleId} AND menu_id=#{value.menuId}
mapper.select: SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM tb_sy_role_menu_auth WHERE role_id=#{roleId} AND menu_id=#{value.menuId})
